```mjs title=main.mjs
import "./side.mjs";
import "./setup.mjs";

// ./ext.mjs

// ./side.mjs

// ./index.js




expect(globalThis.__order).toEqual(['side', 'setup', 'ext']);

export { value } from "./ext.mjs";

```

```mjs title=setup.mjs
// ./setup.mjs
globalThis.__order = globalThis.__order || [];
globalThis.__order.push('setup');
globalThis.ready = true;

export {};
```
